snippet.title: ZOMBUTCHER – Monster Business Simulator | Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the shoes of a zombie butcher in stealth-action simulator. Hide in the shadows of a Louisiana town, avoid night patrols, and gather food and resources for a variety of monsters.

During the day, run your meat shop: sell products to unsuspecting humans. At night, hunt, butcher, and satisfy your zombie cravings… BRA-A-A-INS!

🔥 ZOMBUTCHER Key Features:

Stealth-action gameplay with monster business management

Day & night cycle: run your shop by day, hunt by night

Unique Louisiana-inspired setting

Blend of humor, horror, and strategy

Find us on Steam and follow our journey - link is in a pinned comment
